summary: Iteration 39 frontend-only verification: (1) mobile header wordmark, (2) HowToPlaySection under mobile contests grid, (3) mobile leaderboard current-user highlight + attempts meta, (4) mobile summary card, (5) desktop regression, (6) yarn build. ALL 6 test cases PASS. Signed in as bachanta8@gmail.com and confirmed on contest 'TEST_CheckoutBug_Dyn' that the current user row (rank #2) shows the gold gradient + 'YOU' pill + attempts count, while other rows use dark bg with purple avatar as specified.

issues: The 'mobile-lb-me' summary card at the top AND the current-user's highlighted row in the list both appear together (essentially the user info is duplicated on-screen). Not a bug per spec but worth reviewing if double-display is intentional.

critical_code_review_comments: MobileHome.jsx line 193: uses myRow.duration_s?.toFixed?.(2) with fallback 0 (a number) — this works because optional-chaining short-circuits to undefined when duration_s missing, but when duration_s IS 0 (falsy but valid), (0).toFixed(2) returns '0.00' which is fine. No fix needed, just noting.
MobileHome.jsx: leaderboard useEffect depends on selectedId only; if the same contest data refreshes elsewhere the panel won't refetch. Acceptable for this iteration.

HowToPlaySection passed a `compact` prop but the shared component's behaviour for that prop was not inspected during this iteration — verify it renders sensibly on 390px (screenshot indicates it does, no overflow observed).
